messages:
Alex R: FYI customer hit repeated 500s + malformed structured output on /v1/generate when json_mode=true. They see an HTTP 200 with body that fails our strict parser (invalid JSON) and sometimes numbers are returned quoted. thread opened by Katie - Support.
Katie - Support: Customer: Acme Corp, ticket #INC-12345. They pasted a sample response that breaks their ingestion. Asking for ETA and workaround. :grimacing: They noticed billing jump too (lots of retries).
support-bot: New ticket INC-12345 created, linked to trace abc123.
Sophie L: Can you paste the exact request/response? quick check: often this is model variant returning free text instead of structured because of fallback.
Alex R: Pasted below (redacted token):
```
POST /v1/generate
Authorization: Bearer REDACTED
{
  "model": "stable-gen-v2",
  "json_mode": true,
  "prompt": "render invoice json for order 123",
  "max_tokens": 400
}

RESPONSE (200): 
{
  "invoice_id": "12345",
  "total": "49.99",
  "paid": "false",
  "status": "COMPLETED"
}
```
Alex R: The client expects total as number, paid as boolean. Our strict parser tries to coerce and fails with: "invalid JSON: expected number, got string". They also saw intermittent 500s when we hit dedicated capacity and fallback routing happened.
Matt G: Infra traces show spikes around 2024-09-28T14:12Z -> retries from the SDK. There were 429s on dedicated pool 3 and then routing to hosted fallback which serves a different model variant (model alias mapping mismatch). That fallback sometimes emits free-form text which breaks json_mode.
infra-bot: Trace abc123: 429s -> retry_count 3 -> routed to alias stable-gen-v2:default-fallback.
Sophie L: Hypothesis: recent rollback of tokenizer/merge ops caused numeric tokens to be quoted in one variant. Also enum casing changed to UPPERCASE in fallback variant. This will break strict schema checks.
Katie - Support: Customer asked for short-term workaround. They can not toggle server-side flags. Suggest we provide a client-side patch or a compatibility header.
Alex R: Workaround options: 1) Ask customer to set json_mode=false and parse heuristically (not ideal). 2) We can enable a server-side lenient parse for this customer (coerce_numbers=true, allow_enum_case_insensitive=true) until root fix. 3) Roll back model alias to previous variant to stop fallback.
Sophie L: Repro steps I ran locally against the fallback variant: same output with quoted numbers and uppercase enums. Commands: 
```bash
export TOKEN=REDACTED
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood/v1/generate
 -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"
 -d '{"model":"stable-gen-v2:default-fallback","json_mode":true,"prompt":"render invoice json for order 123"}'
```
Got same malformed reply.
Matt G: We can patch routing table to avoid sending requests to default-fallback while we investigate. I can do a temporary route pin for Acme (customer_id: acme-77) and throttle retries.
Katie - Support: Customer is OK with temporary pin, asks for ETA. They were charged for retries — finance asked for flag to mark those tokens as credit.
Alex R: Action items: 
- Matt G to pin routing for acme-77 to stable-gen-v2:verified (ETA 30m). @Matt G
- Sophie L to root-cause tokenizer/variant diff and confirm why numbers quoted (ETA 3h). @Sophie L
- Katie - Support to request billing credit for INC-12345 and notify customer of workaround (ASAP). @Katie
- I'll add lenient-parse toggle for this customer as short term (if infra allows) and instrument more logging.

Sophie L: One more note — ensure schema validator logs include trace_id so we can map parse failures to upstream responses. Right now parsing fails but we don't have the exact model variant ID in logs.
Alex R: Agreed. Add trace_id to parse error messages. Also tag these requests so billing can be adjusted.
Katie - Support: Customer replied: please do routing pin + billing credit + keep me updated. They can test in ~1h. :thumbsup:
Matt G: Pinned routing for acme-77 to stable-gen-v2:verified. Confirmed no more fallbacks for that customer.
infra-bot: Routing change applied for customer acme-77 by Matt G at 2024-09-28T15:01Z.
Sophie L: Repro confirmed failure is variant-specific. Filing PR to enforce consistent JSON emission in generator wrapper. ETA next patch 6h.
Alex R: Thanks all. Will follow up when Sophie posts the PR. Katie, keep pushing billing credit and share resolution with customer.
Katie - Support: Will do. Closing on our side once billing handled and PR deployed.
